files.description: 10-page PDF documenting the EHI export format. Describes a dual C-CDA (XML) + proprietary CSV export covering 16 C-CDA sections plus 'advanced demographics and remaining EHI' in CSV name-value pair format. Includes section-level summaries and basic XML structure examples but no data dictionary, schema, or sample exports.
Full-page screenshot of the Export Format Documentation page showing the embedded PDF viewer and download button. Captures the page as rendered in the browser.
